name: P&ID Agent
facts: Drawings, equipment ports and connectivity share stable identities through DesignGraph.
A proposed bypass changes which paths need calculation and review.
Generated drawing and computed candidates do not constitute approved design.
Original drawings, changed elements and unresolved inputs remain traceable.
seeds: Drafting bench: orthogonal ink drawing assembles from construction lines, then redline traces.
Isometric process plant: spatial pipes, pump and valve, a visible bypass with physically legible flow.
Revision studio: two translucent engineering sheets align and reveal the local change, powerful redline choreography.
Port choreography: zoom from equipment silhouettes into precise connection ports, route pulses and connection semantics.
Exploded design layers: spatial drawing, port schema and review overlays separate then register as a coherent assembly.
